saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Ουαλεντίνος ο Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Τέρνι»

attestations.note: Terni is the Italian name of Interamna, and the whole of saint.gr's entry is that he was bishop of the city of Terni and was martyred at Rome — the same office as this folder's. The Greek day is 14 February and the Romanian row on this folder keeps him on 30 July; one row per church is the schema, so the two stand side by side. saint.gr keeps a second Valentine on the same 14 February, a presbyter of Rome, on a page of his own, and the two are two men.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 12.08.2026 (30. јул ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Валентин.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry. The identification is the see and the day together: the entry opens «Био епископ у Италијанском граду Интерамни», he was bishop in the Italian city of Interamna, which is this folder's `office` word for word, and the Romanian keeps him on this same menologion day. The serbian row was `undocumented`, so the row lands here. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Свешт. муч.» is the `hieromartyr` held. `dates`: THE FOLDER'S `dates` WAS NULL AND THIS ENTRY GIVES IT ITS FIRST DATE OF ANY KIND, a flat death of 273 off «Сви пострадаше 273. год.», which takes the folder out of the undated tray. NO `locations`. NO NEW `related`: `valentine-of-rome` is already here and untouched. FIVE PEOPLE NAMED IN THE BODY AND NOT ONE FOLDER MADE, AND THE HEADING IS WHY. «Свешт. муч. Валентин.» names ONE man and carries NO company clause of any kind, so the 12-19 `aglaia-of-rome` and 12-28 `domna-of-nicomedia` ruling decides it: a name inside a body is not a heading. The three the entry beheads with him are ENUMERATED BY NAME — «она три ученика Кратонова: Прокул, Евив и Аполоније», the three disciples of Craton — AND THE CORPUS HOLDS NO FOLDER FOR ANY OF THEM; granting them three folders, or three rows if they existed, is one line for the author, and this is the day's second-largest finding. The philosopher «Кратон» and his son «Херимон», whom Valentine straightened, and «Фронтон» the tribune's brother are likewise no folders. «Авундије», the Roman eparch's son who buried the bodies, IS NOT `abundius-of-rome`: that folder is the martyr of 258 kept by the Russian on 13 August in the company of Hippolytus and Lawrence at Rome, fifteen years later and in another story, so no row was made on it. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, which is this folder's whole narrative: the healing of the tribune Fronto's brother; Chaeremon drawn up so that his head was bent down between his knees; the night the bishop shut himself in the room with the sick boy in prayer, and the boy led out next morning perfectly well and given back to his father; the baptism of Craton with his whole household and his three disciples; Chaeremon leaving his father's house to go with Valentine; the baptism of the eparch's son; and the eparch, enraged at that, seizing Valentine and beheading him with the sword after torture. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Şi părtaş obiceiurilor şi următor scaunelor Apostolilor fiind, lucrare ai aflat, de Dumnezeu insuflate, spre suirea privirii la cele înalte. Pentru aceasta, cuvântul adevărului drept învăţând şi cu credinţă răbdând până la sânge, Sfinţite Mucenice Valentin, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

english.text: A sharer in their ways and a successor to the apostles' thrones, you found in action, God-inspired one, a way up to the vision of the things on high. Therefore, rightly teaching the word of truth and enduring in faith even to blood, hieromartyr Valentine, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

death.note: The folder's first date of any kind: `dates` was null, neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr giving a year. The Охридски пролог for 30. јул ст. ст. closes the entry «Сви пострадаше 273. год. и посташе грађани царства небеског» — they all suffered in 273, which the book says of the bishop and of the three disciples of Craton beheaded with him. No year of birth and no age is given. Read 8 October 2026.
